editorial_intent: Diagrams the systemic collapse of long-range neural network synchronization caused by cellular energy deficits in a biophysical brain model.
subject: A polarized neuronal membrane and mitochondrial energy pump driving cooperative dipole oscillations across distributed cortical layers.
setting: A geometric cranial meridian dome, 24-division circadian astrolabe calibration arc, and phase-coherent geodesic neural constellation woven into the schematic framing.
composition: asymmetric Post-Constructivist and Bauhaus scientific lithograph featuring a left-to-right causal sequence of electrical phase-coherence breaking down into thermodynamic decay
